title: Distributionally Robust Optimization with Probabilistic Group

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the CelebA dataset where gender (male/female) acts as a spurious feature correlated with the target classification label (hair color).

Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset to measure toxicity prediction performance across comments associated with various demographic identities, including gender, race, sexual orientation, and religion (e.g., male, female, White, Black, LGBTQ, Muslim, Christian).

Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset to assess the model's reliance on spurious background context features (water vs. land background) rather than the actual subject (waterbird vs. landbird).

Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the MultiNLI dataset to assess the model's reliance on spurious associations between the target label (contradictory) and the presence of negation words (e.g., nobody, no, never).
